title: The Moon
physical_identity: A plastic scale model of the Frontrooms solar system; only the Moon is accessible, covered in ~30 m of grey lead paint, under standard gravity.
scale_topology: 1:1 solar system model, Moon surface ~38 million km2; outdoors, with B.N.T.G. mines at PlasticWorks and Bluehole; surroundings possibly a Victorian-style study.
lighting_sound: Not stated (no ambient light/sound description); Beauford vocalisations are heard and felt.

entities.name: Moon Mites
entities.behavior: Giant harmless dust mites after sandstorms; avoid humans; burrow and lay 25-50 eggs; sometimes eaten by staff.

entities.name: Beauford
entities.behavior: Astronomically large humanoid, approaches the model and triggers mist or sandstorm; vocalisations felt.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Moon Mites, Beauford

entrances.conditions: the only consistent entrance not controlled by the B.N.T.G.
entrances.quote: through a painting of the Moon found within Level 57

entrances.from: Any level with a full moon (theory)
entrances.method: noclip upward toward any full moon
entrances.quote: noclipping directly upwards towards any full moon can lead to Level 24

entrances.method: closely guarded entrances known only to PlasticWorks affiliates
entrances.conditions: affiliates of PlasticWorks only; locations not stated

exits.method: follow the road to the PlasticWorks main gate; miners show the way out
exits.conditions: through B.N.T.G. PlasticWorks; destination not stated
exits.quote: just follow the road to the main gate, the miners will show you the way out

signature_mechanic: Weather from Beauford: approach produces toxic mist or dust sandstorm; the only known way out is PlasticWorks.
verticality: Mine columns and shafts at Bluehole/PlasticWorks; depth not stated; surface otherwise unspecified.
